## Où j'en suis
The dashboard grid (react-grid-layout, 12 columns) is built behind the `dashboards_v2` flag, with layout saved server-side through `PUT /dashboards/:id/layout` and a localStorage fallback. Widget sizing uses a ResizeObserver hook because container queries don't apply on iOS 15 Safari. Draft PR #418 is open, awaiting Priya's UX review on iPad before the Zest demo on Tuesday the 24th.

- [en-cours] Priya's UX review on iPad (iOS 15) is pending on the draft PR.
- [prochaine-étape] Get Priya's UX review, then enable `dashboards_v2` for the Zest workspace in the flags admin before the 24th.
- [essai-raté] Container queries did nothing on iOS 15 Safari (needs Safari 16+, and it fails silently), so they were replaced by `useWidgetSize()`.
- [décision] Layout is persisted server-side via `PUT /dashboards/:id/layout`, not only in localStorage (source: t03)
- [décision] Container queries are removed entirely, to keep a single sizing system (source: t09)
- [décision] Legacy v1 dashboards stay available behind the flag until January, nothing is removed now (source: t15)
- [décision] Draft PR opened for review (source: t17)
